sanitization: Explicit numeric, Boolean, digest and fixed-label allowlist; queries only from the pinned public manifest. No source text, raw diagnostic messages, commands, local paths or credentials copied.

methodology.input: Bounded existing JSON metadata only; no corpus, database, engine or source reads, SQL, subprocesses, copies or hashes.
methodology.identity: Recorded engine directory label and corpus SHA validated against supplied frozen-engine seals and public pins; engine contents are not rehashed here.
methodology.distributions: Final median/min/max require at least three fully qualified completed repetitions with equal semantic graph fingerprints. Raw n=1/2 observations remain in attempts only.
methodology.pilots: 84dc239 root-preflight, 61512ca convergence, 1086f0a witness-cache and b6df16b owner-pattern-cache experiments are retained separately and never included in final aggregates. b6df16b is rejected for confirmed cross-lookup proof-cache recall dependence; its completed normal runs and other validations remain historical evidence. Later revisions are not selected implicitly.
methodology.processTime: Report elapsedMs used for whole-harness distributions; scheduler elapsed retained separately as metadata.
methodology.caps: Recorded caps are retained without assuming 600 seconds. Primary timing groups require one known positive cap, and arm comparisons require identical caps; otherwise timing deltas are withheld. Completion and correctness records remain intact, and an earlier timeout never becomes a completed observation.
methodology.operatorStops: The known b6df16b GHC-core sidecar records an operator SIGTERM to investigate cache-history recall, not an 1800-second timeout. Process status/elapsed and the separately validated stop reason are retained without reclassifying the attempt as complete.
methodology.temporalProvenance: Primary timing requires explicit 20 September UTC start dates as well as new arm labels. The earlier baseline and selected-engine runs spanning 19–20 September remain non-primary: unchanged-code Pandoc timing changed substantially across the interruption, so those days must not be pooled into a production speedup claim. Missing or different dates withhold timing distributions while preserving completed correctness evidence.
methodology.noChange: Three sync samples within each run; summary uses median of per-run medians.
methodology.flow: Actual explore Flow presence and parsed steps; internal named graph paths are excluded. Flow excerpt truncation is not full-response truncation.
methodology.integrity: Harness quick_check, FK and orphan-edge evidence only. Full integrity_check and exact semantic row comparison require separate diagnostics.
methodology.disk: Before-close sizes from reports only; no checkpoint, vacuum, physical-file or page/freelist measurement.

historicalEvidence.qualification: Preserved baseline and selected-engine observations before the fresh 20 September comparison; same-build selected results retain graph evidence but are excluded from primary timing distributions because execution dates and host/cache conditions are confounded. No mixed-day median is computed.

interruption.qualification: Partial progress and overnight elapsed time are not completion duration. Preserved separately before a fresh-copy retry; never aggregated as a completed observation.

expressArchivePreparation.qualification: Preparation failed before indexing; the empty destination was preserved separately. No index latency or completed measurement is inferred.

operatorStop.reason: Operator stopped to investigate a statically identified cross-lookup proof-cache recall/reproducibility concern before completing the candidate selection. Not a timeout.

rejections.candidate-owner-cache-20260919: Immutable-graph ABSENT/SINGLETON proofs retained across distinct lookups change depth-limited recall after another query. No false target was shown; final selection was rejected and its first GHC-core attempt was stopped by the operator, not timed out.

pilotEvidence.qualification: Historical experimental observations, including completed normal runs, capped runs and an explicit operator stop; no experimental observations enter final aggregates or validate a replacement revision.

productionSelection.baselineReuse: All baseline-20260920 observations are the earlier same-day executions. The candidate-only constructor campaign did not rerun or interleave them. Temporal, thermal and filesystem-cache conditions are not controlled by same-day eligibility.
